name: v0.3.2
body:
## What's Changed
* Multiplatform Support - Platform Specific Project Management by @pnck in https://github.com/pnck/foo_input_ncm/pull/2
* Pipeline / Continuous Build by @pnck in https://github.com/pnck/foo_input_ncm/pull/3

## New Contributors
* @pnck made their first contribution in https://github.com/pnck/foo_input_ncm/pull/2

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pnck/foo_input_ncm/compare/v0.2.0...v0.3.2

### Features:
- Load and play ncm file like other audio formats directly in foobar2000
- Correctly present meta info and embeded album artwork of the music track

### Notice:  
- Replay gain rewrite is not supported yet

### Features:
- Load and play ncm file like other audio formats directly in foobar2000
- Correctly present meta info of the music track (other than album artwork)  

### Notice:  
- Replay gain rewrite is not supported yet
- Embeded album artwork is not supported yet
